title: Alphawaves dataset
description: The Alphawaves dataset comprises resting-state EEG recordings from 19 healthy participants acquired using a 16-channel g.tec g.USBamp system at 512 Hz sampling rate. Participants alternated between eyes-closed and eyes-open conditions in 10-second trials. The raw, unpreprocessed data serves as a benchmark resource for brain-computer interface research and resting-state EEG analysis, with event-related synchronization (ERS) analysis in the alpha frequency band (8-12 Hz) as a suggested analysis method.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 19 healthy subjects using a 16-channel g.tec g.USBamp amplifier with wet electrodes referenced to the right earlobe, sampled at 512 Hz with a standard 10-10 montage. Participants performed a resting-state paradigm alternating between eyes-closed and eyes-open conditions in 10-second trials. Data were recorded using OpenViBE software with no online digital filtering applied.
